sn38.7:1.9: “But, reverend, what path and what practice, for completely understanding these three feelings?”
sn38.7:1.10: “Reverend, it is simply this noble eightfold path for completely understanding these three feelings, that is—
sn38.7:1.12: Reverend, this is the path, this is the practice, for completely understanding these three feelings.”
sn38.7:1.13: “Reverend, this is a fine path, a fine practice, for completely understanding these three feelings.
sn38.7:1.14: And just this much is enough for diligence, Reverend Sāriputta.”
